purpose.objective: Test H5 divergence/catch-up and H6 regime dependency, centered on whether high Brent and high USDRUBF levels precede USDRUBF declines.

inputs.phase6_source_panel: explicit path required and semantic replay must reproduce frozen Phase6 dataset

methodology.primary_direction: negative USDRUBF forward return (short USD / long RUB)
methodology.bootstrap_unit: date-aligned circular blocks over the full chronological valid horizon series; conditional and unconditional means use the same draw
methodology.temporal_stability_partition: fixed chronological thirds of the full research period before regime filtering

interpretation.H5: High Brent + high USDRUBF divergence/catch-up evidence is based only on negative high-high forward returns, short hit-rate and calendar stability.
interpretation.H6: Regime dependency is assessed separately and requires high-high returns to be more negative than unconditional returns with calendar stability.
interpretation.multiple_horizon_rule: overall H5/H6 status uses pre-declared 5/10/20 session confirmation counts; strongest horizon is descriptive only

gates.G1_phase6_lineage: frozen Phase6 hashes and source-panel semantic replay PASS
gates.G2_brent_admission: exact accepted Phase8.4A hashes and G1-G9 PASS
gates.G3_pit_levels: Brent and USDRUBF levels are prior_trade_date closes only
gates.G4_percentile_pit: rolling percentiles use current/prior observations only, never future observations
gates.G5_regime_fixed: 126/63 window, 0.75/0.25 thresholds and regime definitions are fixed
gates.G6_labels: 1/3/5/10/20-session labels are separate future outcomes; terminal unbound endpoint is structural null
gates.G7_no_oil_rub_leakage: Brent*USDRUBF product is never constructed or used
gates.G8_research_only: no model fit, optimization, trading rules, sizing, broker or trading actions
